report.verdict: Payments infrastructure is the first thing I notice, and your work backs up the senior title with production scale and measurable results. I'd want to talk to you.
write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for senior backend work: you connect payment systems to throughput, uptime and latency! The move from freight technology to Lumen Ledger builds a clear story around services that businesses rely on.
The balance API line is a great model: it names the change you made and shows latency before and after. Your headline fits the work, and Experience leads with your current role.

Your resume isn't likely to be what holds you back from a call. Competition for the role still matters. For a step up, add a broader technical decision if you have one, and bring the latency result closer to the top.

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 1
cards.line: Designed and built the idempotent payouts service in Go and PostgreSQL that now settles about 1.8M payouts a month
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It gives a recruiter the service, your ownership, the tools and how much work the service handles.

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 2
cards.line: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends
cards.cannot_tell: For a role one level up, a recruiter will look for technical direction beyond one migration. A broader decision you made would show that work if it's part of your story.
cards.example: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends and set [broader system direction]
cards.question: What broader system direction did you set, if any?

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 3
cards.line: Cut p99 latency on the balance API from 900 ms to 140 ms by moving reads to a Kafka-fed cache
cards.cannot_tell: Consider moving this above the migration line. The before and after makes the improvement immediately tangible.

fit.why: Your headline and current payments platform work both point to senior backend engineering.
fit.level: senior, leads a ledger migration and mentors two engineers
fit.note: Your recent work points toward backend roles involving payments, distributed data and service reliability. The freight and insurance roles add Java service experience.
